description: Required Q4 coverage: the negative test. An ordinary, uneventful call with small talk, hedging and half-finished sentences, and NO real signal. A system that fires nudges here is producing exactly the low-value alert spam the assessment calls a rejection condition. Correct behaviour is near-silence.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Good morning, this is Anaya, an AI assistant. This call is recorded for quality purposes. I'm calling about your business loan enquiry.

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Oh, hello. Sorry, one second, the traffic here is very loud.

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Yes, sorry. What was it about again? I think I filled something online, maybe.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: That's right, an enquiry about a business loan. Is this a good time to talk?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Umm, I mean, it's okay I suppose. The weather has been terrible so things are a bit, you know, slow to start today.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: I understand. Could you tell me a little about the business?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Yes, it's a small thing, we've been doing it a while. Nothing very exciting. My cousin also does something similar in another city.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Got it. And roughly what does the business turn over in a year?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Oh, that I would have to check with my accountant, I never remember these numbers.
